title: Preservation of fan-in two
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $m+n$ input bits and at most two arguments at each gate; assume also that each gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. For any assignment to the first $m$ inputs, the circuit obtained by hardwiring those inputs still has at most two arguments at each gate, distinct arguments at each gate, and exactly one argument at every NOT gate.
hypotheses_covered: Each gate of $C$ has at most two arguments
Each gate of $C$ has distinct arguments
Every NOT gate of $C$ has exactly one argument
$y$ assigns Boolean values to the first $m$ inputs
